ingress_allowlist_enforced.title: Ingress Allowlist Enforced
ingress_allowlist_enforced.description: Whether strict allowlist-based ingress filtering is configured on the application tier boundary to restrict traffic arriving from the DMZ or presentation layer.

permitted_protocols.title: Permitted Ingress Protocols
permitted_protocols.description: List of network protocols explicitly allowed on the ingress filter at the application tier boundary (e.g., ['HTTPS', 'HTTP']). Non-application protocols such as SSH, RDP, ICMP, Telnet indicate over-permissiveness.

source_ip_restriction_applied.title: Source IP Restriction Applied
source_ip_restriction_applied.description: Whether ingress rules on the application tier restrict allowed source IPs or CIDR ranges to only known DMZ/presentation-layer addresses, rather than permitting broad or any-source traffic.

default_ingress_policy.title: Default Ingress Policy
default_ingress_policy.description: The default action applied to traffic not explicitly matched by ingress rules at the application tier boundary.

egress_acl_enforced.title: Egress ACL Enforced on App Tier
egress_acl_enforced.description: Whether port-level and protocol-level egress filtering rules are applied to outbound traffic from application tier servers toward backend systems.

permitted_egress_scope.title: Permitted Egress Scope
permitted_egress_scope.description: The breadth of outbound connectivity allowed from app tier components to backend tiers, describing how specifically egress is constrained.

east_west_inspection_enabled.title: East-West Traffic Inspection Enabled
east_west_inspection_enabled.description: Whether lateral (east-west) traffic from app tier to backend tier passes through an inspection point such as an IDS/IPS, next-gen firewall, or service mesh policy enforcer.

intra_zone_acl_enforced.title: Intra-Zone Access Control Lists Enforced
intra_zone_acl_enforced.description: Whether explicit access control lists or firewall rules are enforced between web servers and application servers within the same security boundary, preventing unrestricted peer-to-peer communication.

microsegmentation_technology.title: Microsegmentation Technology in Use
microsegmentation_technology.description: The technology or mechanism used to enforce microsegmentation or intra-zone access controls between components within the application tier boundary.

east_west_traffic_monitored.title: East-West Intra-Zone Traffic Monitored
east_west_traffic_monitored.description: Whether network traffic between web servers and application servers within the same boundary is captured and monitored by an IDS, flow logging, or equivalent visibility tool capable of detecting anomalous lateral movement.

service_account_scope.title: Service Account Scope
service_account_scope.description: Indicates whether service accounts or API keys are shared across multiple application tier components (web servers, app servers) or are unique per component.

internal_interface_reauth_enforced.title: Internal Interface Re-authentication Enforced
internal_interface_reauth_enforced.description: Whether internal interfaces between application tier components require independent re-authentication rather than relying on inherited or propagated trust from the calling component's identity.

credential_rotation_days.title: Service Account Credential Rotation Period (Days)
credential_rotation_days.description: Number of days between mandatory rotation of service account credentials or API keys used within the application tier.

boundary_traffic_inspection_enabled.title: Boundary Traffic Inspection Enabled
boundary_traffic_inspection_enabled.description: Whether deep packet inspection or equivalent network traffic analysis is active at the application tier ingress and egress points.

boundary_traffic_logging_scope.title: Boundary Traffic Logging Scope
boundary_traffic_logging_scope.description: Extent of network traffic logging at the application tier boundary: whether ingress, egress, both, or neither are captured.

log_forwarding_to_siem_configured.title: Boundary Logs Forwarded to SIEM
log_forwarding_to_siem_configured.description: Whether boundary traffic logs are actively forwarded to a centralized SIEM or log aggregation platform for correlation and alerting.

cross_zone_alert_rules_count.title: Cross-Zone Anomaly Alert Rules Count
cross_zone_alert_rules_count.description: Number of active detection or alerting rules specifically targeting anomalous cross-zone traffic at the application tier boundary.

dedicated_oob_management_network_configu.title: Dedicated Out-of-Band Management Network Configured
dedicated_oob_management_network_configu.description: Whether SSH, RDP, and management API traffic is routed through a dedicated out-of-band management network or VLAN that is physically or logically separate from application traffic paths.

management_protocols_allowed_on_app_ingr.title: Management Protocols Permitted on Application Ingress Path
management_protocols_allowed_on_app_ingr.description: List of management protocols (e.g., SSH, RDP, HTTPS-MGMT-API) whose traffic is permitted inbound on the same network interface or security group rules that carry normal application traffic.

management_access_source_restricted_to_m.title: Management Access Source Restricted to Management Zone CIDRs
management_access_source_restricted_to_m.description: Whether inbound management traffic (SSH, RDP, management APIs) is restricted by source IP to management-zone CIDRs only, preventing access from untrusted or application-tier source ranges.

certificate_trust_store_scope.title: Certificate Trust Store Scope
certificate_trust_store_scope.description: Indicates whether internal TLS connections use a tightly scoped private CA trust store, the system/OS-wide trust store (which includes public CAs), or accept all certificates without validation.

self_signed_certificates_in_use.title: Self-Signed Certificates In Use for Inter-Zone TLS
self_signed_certificates_in_use.description: Whether any inter-zone TLS connections use self-signed certificates rather than certificates issued by a managed CA.

certificate_pinning_enforced.title: Certificate Pinning Enforced for Inter-Zone Connections
certificate_pinning_enforced.description: Whether inter-zone TLS clients enforce certificate or public-key pinning to prevent substitution of trusted-but-unauthorized certificates.

outbound_destination_restriction.title: Outbound Destination Restriction Policy
outbound_destination_restriction.description: Whether egress traffic from the application tier is restricted to an explicit allowlist of approved external destinations, or permits arbitrary external destinations.

egress_protocols_unrestricted.title: Unrestricted Egress Protocols
egress_protocols_unrestricted.description: List of protocols/ports that are permitted outbound from the application tier to arbitrary external destinations without restriction.

egress_traffic_inspection_enabled.title: Egress Traffic Inspection Enabled
egress_traffic_inspection_enabled.description: Whether outbound traffic from the application tier is subject to deep packet inspection or proxied through a monitored egress point that can detect and block anomalous exfiltration patterns.

middleware_content_inspection_enabled.title: Middleware Content Inspection Enabled
middleware_content_inspection_enabled.description: Whether deep content-level inspection (payload validation, schema enforcement, or WAF-style filtering) is applied to AMQP/JMS messages traversing the application tier boundary.

middleware_sender_authentication_enforce.title: Middleware Sender Authentication Enforced
middleware_sender_authentication_enforce.description: Whether the message broker or middleware endpoint authenticates the identity of message producers before accepting messages at the application tier boundary.

middleware_protocol_exposure_zone.title: Middleware Protocol Exposure Zone
middleware_protocol_exposure_zone.description: The network zone from which AMQP/JMS broker ports are accessible, indicating whether the middleware is exposed beyond the internal application tier.

failover_paths_policy_parity.title: Failover Paths Have Policy Parity
failover_paths_policy_parity.description: Whether all load balancer failover paths, secondary NICs, and backup connectivity routes enforce the same security policies as the primary boundary enforcement path.

redundant_path_inspection_enabled.title: Traffic Inspection Enabled on Redundant Paths
redundant_path_inspection_enabled.description: Whether deep packet inspection, IDS/IPS, or equivalent traffic analysis is actively applied to redundant and failover network paths, not just the primary path.

failover_boundary_crossing_logged.title: Boundary Crossing Events Logged During Failover
failover_boundary_crossing_logged.description: Whether boundary crossing events are captured in logs when traffic transits redundant or failover paths, providing full audit trail parity with primary path logging.
